papers.note: Batch 020 manual primary-PDF extraction. Abstract, methods/definitions, results, and Tables 1-7 were checked (article pp. 123-127). papers.note: Batch 020 manual primary-PDF extraction. Methods, Tables 1-5, and Figures 1-3 were checked (article pp. 26-33). This is a single pooled youth-professional cohort; Figure 2's age bars were not used because its visual totals are not fully reconcilable with the printed 62-event total and it provides no age-specific exposure. Direct total, match/training, incidence, burden, severity, and recurrence data are retained. The printed total exposure (99,224 h) differs by 22 h from the printed match-plus-training sum (99,246 h); both direct source values are retained and not reconciled. The GRSI-specific diagnoses do not have one-to-one structured schema rows, so their direct total is retained in the generic injury-diagnosis structured row rather than forced into a narrower tissue category.

papers.note: Batch 020 manual primary-PDF extraction. Methods, Tables 1-2, results, and discussion were checked (article pp. 175-182). This is a single-team prospective Spanish professional cohort across the 2020-2021 and 2021-2022 seasons. The paper provides direct match and training incidence but no season-wide exposure totals, so no exposure was calculated from its rates. The target condition is non-contact calf muscle strain; the direct muscle and lower-leg structured rows are retained, while target diagnosis/location are not echoed as a most-common outcome. Reviewer attention: the results state 68.7% reinjuries (11/16), while a later discussion sentence says 9/16; the direct results percentage and compatible count are retained.

papers.note: Batch 020 manual primary-PDF extraction. Methods, Tables 1-7, and Graphs 1-5 were checked (article pp. 16-25). The direct layout is total followed by the five leagues. Table 1 supplies each league's match exposure and average player age; the article supplies direct injuries and lay-off days by league. The pooled injury count and lay-off days are transparent sums of the five reported league values, while pooled incidence and burden were not calculated. Graph 4 is used for the direct league burden values; it reports Ligue 1 as 193.53 despite an inconsistent 186.67 value in nearby prose, so the labelled graph value is retained. This is a target knee-ligament cohort; structured ligament/knee counts are retained, but the target is not duplicated as a most-common diagnosis/type/location.
